name: Network marketer
pitch: Speak a real story once. Ship authentic posts all week.

profile.goals: Turn real product and recruiting conversations into daily posts that sound like me, not copy-paste scripts.
profile.projects: Product stories, recruiting invites, weekly wins, team culture.
profile.brand_voice: Confident, human, story-first. Sound like a real call, not a canned script. No pressure-close language.

traits.target_audience: Prospects and downline who respond to authenticity over hype.
